items.title: 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities (insani kaamon se pani ki pollution) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.4 (PDF 254-255). Quick Check answers were written for the lesson and need review.

blocks.text: Human activities (insan ke kaam) poori duniya mein pani ki pollution ki bari wajah hain. Aabadi barhti hai aur industries phailti hain to zyada waste aur pollutants pani mein jate hain. Improper waste management (kachre ka ghalat intezam) aur environmental regulations (mahol ke qanoon) ki kami ki wajah se aksar contaminants (gandagi) daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron tak pohanch jate hain.

Industry pani ki pollution ka sab se bara source hai. Factories aksar harmful (nuqsan-deh) chemicals, heavy metals aur zehreela waste seedha daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein daal deti hain. Pollution phailane wali aam industries: oil refineries, chemical plants, gariyon ki industry (automobile), fertilizer (khaad) ki factories aur tanneries (chamra rangne ke karkhane) waghera.

Kheton se behta pani (runoff) fertilizers, pesticides aur herbicides qareeb ke pani mein le jata hai; is tarah kheti pollution mein bara hissa dalti hai. Poor irrigation practices (aabpashi ke ghalat tareeqon) se mitti zyada katti hai (soil erosion) aur mitti (sediments) daryaon aur naalon mein beh jati hai. Bohat se ilaqon mein kheton ki drainage (nikasi ka pani) pollutants le kar zameen ke oopar ke pani (surface water) aur zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) dono ko ganda karta hai.
3. Domestic and Municipal Waste (gharon aur shehron ka kachra)

Gharon aur shehron ka waste pani ki pollution ke bare sources mein se ek hai. Bohat se ilaqon mein shehron ka bina saaf kiya ya kam saaf kiya gaya sewage aur thos kachra seedha daryaon, jheelon ya samandaron mein daal diya jata hai, jis se nuqsan-deh bacteria aur viruses pani mein aa jate hain. Gharon ka waste, jaise detergents, tel aur chemicals, naaliyon mein ja kar aakhir pani tak pohanchta hai. Khaas taur par plastic aksar naaliyon aur nehron mein ya un ke qareeb phenka jata hai, jis se raaste band (blockage) hote hain aur lambe arse ki pollution hoti hai.
4. Deforestation and Land Use for Urban Development (jangal katna aur shehron ke liye zameen ka istemal)

Deforestation (darakht katna) aur land use (zameen ka istemal) pani ki pollution ko kafi barhate hain. Jab darakht aur vegetation (sabza) hata diye jate hain to mitti dheeli ho jati hai aur erosion (katne) ka zyada khatra hota hai, is liye daryaon aur naalon mein mitti (sediment) barh jati hai. Yeh mitti waterways (pani ke raaste) band karti, aquatic habitats (pani ke jaandaron ke ghar) kharab karti aur pani ki quality girati hai. Urban development aur construction (taameer) bhi runoff water (behte pani) mein pollutants aur debris (malba) daalti hai.

Boating (kashti chalana), swimming (tairaki) aur camping ka theek intezam na ho to yeh bhi pollution phailati hain. Kashtiyan aksar tel, fuel aur doosre chemicals pani mein chhorti hain jo aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) ko nuqsan dete hain. Visitors (sayyah) plastic, khane ke rapper aur doosra kachra phenk kar jheelon aur daryaon ko ganda karte hain.
6. Marine Transport (samandar mein jahazon ki aamad-o-raft)

Jahaz aur kashtiyan tel, fuel aur doosre chemicals chhor kar pani ko ganda karte hain. Accidental oil spills (ghalti se tel girna) aur jahazon (vessels) ka wastewater aur sewage pollution ki bari wajah hain. Routine maintenance (aam dekh-bhaal), jaise hull (jahaz ka neeche ka dhancha) ki safai aur painting, bhi toxic substances (zehreele maadde) pani mein chhorti hai. Yeh sab mil kar aquatic life ko nuqsan aur pani ki quality ko kharab karte hain.

Ek mulk mein darya teen ilaqon ke paas se guzarta hai: (1) rural (dehi) ilaqa jahan bohat bari kheti aur bohat cattle (maweshi) hain; (2) industrial ilaqa jahan paint aur battery ki bohat si factories hain; (3) bare shehar ka bara residential (rihaishi) ilaqa.

blocks.prompt: i. Rural ilaqe mein darya mein kis qism ke pollutants jayenge: organic, inorganic ya dono? Do ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono. Organic: cattle ka gobar (animal waste) aur pesticides. Inorganic: fertilizers, jaise ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃) aur phosphates.

blocks.prompt: ii. Industrial ilaqe ke qareeb kaun si metals pani ko sab se zyada ganda karengi?
blocks.explanation: Paint aur battery ki factories se lead (Pb) aur cadmium (Cd); batteries se mercury (Hg) bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: iii. Kaun se ilaqe aise chemicals dalenge jo eutrophication karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Rural ilaqa (fertilizer wala behta pani aur gobar: nitrogen aur phosphorus) aur residential ilaqa (sewage aur phosphate wale detergents).

blocks.prompt: iv. Residential ilaqe ke qareeb pani ko ganda karne wali chaar cheezein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Misal: sewage (bacteria aur viruses ke saath), detergents, gharon ka tel aur chemicals, aur plastic ya thos kachra.

items: Insani sources: industry (sab se bara), kheti, gharon aur shehron ka kachra, deforestation aur construction, tafreeh (recreation), marine transport.
Improper waste management aur regulations ki kami gandagi ko daryaon aur samandaron tak pohanchati hai.
